title: libddb effective process configuration
description: DDBGetEffectiveConfig (new in 2.0): every setting of the process configuration with its value and where the value comes from. The settings object is accepted by DDBConfigure as is.

cpuPoolSize.description: Worker threads beside the calling threads, across the process (CPU token pool)

minFreeDiskMb.description: Free MiB a build needs on its volume; 0 turns the check off

gdalCacheMb.description: Size of GDAL's block cache in MiB, shared by the whole process: the size DDBConfigure set, else the bound from DDB_GDAL_CACHE_MB or the default 1024 (libddb lowers GDAL's own default to it, never raises it, and a GDAL_CACHEMAX set explicitly wins)

hardwareThreads.description: The cores libddb sees, at least 1 (the fixture normalises it to 0)

source.description: DDBConfigure, the setting's environment variable, or the built-in default
